title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Gorak Shep grid point, 25–31 May 2016–2025
claims: The requested grid point at 27.9807 N, 86.8289 E returns an elevation of 5,157 m, near Gorak Shep below the Everest Base Camp start.
For 25–31 May 2016–2025 (70 day-samples), daily high temperatures ranged from -2.6 to 7.8 °C with a median of 0.6 °C.
Daily low temperatures ranged from -12.0 to 0.3 °C with a median of -5.0 °C.
32 of 70 days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation; 8 of 70 recorded at least 5 mm; the single-day maximum was 42.5 mm.
These are modelled grid-point reanalysis values, not measurements taken on the race course; the grid sits below the EBC start and above the Namche finish, so it cannot represent either end exactly.
